**DNS, REST and a young ICS school**

> DNS、REST 与年轻的 ICS 学院

## Why it matters (为何重要)

UC Irvine's ICS school turned out two of the web's foundational ideas and still teaches systems with unusual clarity.

> UCI 的 ICS 学院孕育了两个 Web 基石思想，至今仍以异常清晰的方式教系统。

## Background (背景)

Opened in 1965 with 116 faculty and 1,589 students; its information and computer science department was founded in 1968 and became the UC system's first independent ICS school in 2002.

> 1965 年开学，初始规模为 116 名教师、1,589 名学生；信息与计算机科学系成立于 1968 年，2002 年成为加州大学系统首个独立的 ICS 学院。

## People (人物)

| Person | Connection to computing |
|:--|:--|
| — | **Paul Mockapetris** (PhD '81) — invented the Domain Name System. **Roy Fielding** (BS '88, MS '93, PhD '00) — co-founded the Apache Group and authored the REST architectural style. |

> **Paul Mockapetris**（1981 博士）— 发明域名系统（DNS）。**Roy Fielding**（1988 学士、1993 硕士、2000 博士）— Apache Group 联合创始人，REST 架构风格的提出者。

## In this book (本书收录)

- [025 · Linked lists / stacks / queues (ECS 36C)](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/025-uci-ecs36c-linkedlist)
- [026 · BST & AVL (ICS 46)](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/026-uci-ics46-bst-avl)

**ECS36C's linked structures and ICS46's AVL trees are the two halves of UCI's data-structure apprenticeship — implement it, then prove it balances.**

> ECS36C 的链表结构与 ICS46 的 AVL 树是 UCI 数据结构训练的两半：先实现，再证明它平衡。
